_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: Classic chicken noodle soup with tender chicken, carrots, celery, and egg noodles in a savory herb broth.

items.name: Blueberry, Pecan & Feta Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Mixed greens topped with fresh blueberries, toasted pecans, thin-shaved shallots, and crumbled feta. Dressing served on the side.

items.name: Roast Beef & Mozzarella Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Thin-sliced roast beef with horseradish sauce and melted mozzarella, pressed crisp on our house bread.

items.name: Herb Roasted Gold Potatoes
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Crispy roasted gold potato wedges seasoned with salt, pepper, garlic, and onion.

items.name: Banana Cream Pudding
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Creamy banana pudding layered with fresh banana slices and topped with a vanilla wafer.
